title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: demurrage day rates for reefer-class containers
content:
## Scope

This rate card gives the demurrage day rates for a container of the **reefer rate class** under each product of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category. Rates are in USD per container per day, one rate for each of the four charge slabs.

## Demurrage day rates, reefer class

| Product | Slab 1 day rate | Slab 2 day rate | Slab 3 day rate | Slab 4 day rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 150.00 | 225.00 | 320.00 | 420.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 150.00 | 225.00 | 320.00 | 420.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 150.00 | 225.00 | 320.00 | 420.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 150.00 | 225.00 | 320.00 | 420.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 150.00 | 225.00 | 320.00 | 420.00 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 120.00 | 180.00 | 256.00 | 336.00 |

The five products AHL Tariff Free Time, AHL Free Time Extension 3, AHL Free Time Extension 7, AHL Combined Free Time 14 and AHL Combined Free Time 21 share one reefer-class demurrage rate ladder; AHL Contract Free Time 30 has its own, lower ladder.

## Reading the card

**Q: What is the reefer-class demurrage day rate in slab 3 under AHL Free Time Extension 7?**
A: USD 320.00 per container per day.

**Q: What is the reefer-class demurrage rate for a slab 4 day under AHL Contract Free Time 30?**
A: USD 336.00 per container per day, against USD 420.00 under the other five products.

This card states the reefer-class demurrage rate of each slab only; the rate class of a given container and the slab of a given day are decided by the rules that govern them.
